reinvestment_runway_score.method: 20 points per independently approved category, cap 100

categories.committed_capacity_expansion: measurable new or expanded production/service capacity with board/management commitment
categories.multi_phase_growth_roadmap: two or more identifiable future expansion phases, facilities or rollout stages
categories.funding_visibility: internal accruals, sanctioned finance, cash balance, completed fund raise or other specific funding source for announced expansion
categories.physical_or_operational_headroom: land, installed capacity, modular infrastructure, licensed capacity or facility headroom that can support additional growth
categories.ramp_or_utilisation_headroom: recently commissioned or underutilised capacity with explicit ramp-up path or demand visibility

moat_evidence_score.method: 20 points per independently approved category, cap 100

categories.proprietary_or_ip: patent, proprietary process, owned technology, specialised know-how or demonstrably differentiated product capability
categories.qualification_or_regulatory_barrier: customer qualification, regulatory approval, certification or technical validation that materially raises entry barriers
categories.customer_stickiness: repeat orders, long customer tenure, long-term supply agreement, embedded design relationship or switching-friction evidence
categories.cost_process_or_scale_advantage: specific manufacturing/process/yield/sourcing/scale advantage supported by evidence rather than assertion
categories.market_position_or_limited_competition: credible market leadership, sole/limited approved vendor position, scarce capability or limited qualified competition

new_product_export_optionalities_score.method: 20 points per independently approved category, cap 100

categories.new_product_or_platform: commercially relevant new product/platform/service introduced or under specific launch/approval path
categories.new_customer_or_vendor_approval: named or clearly evidenced new customer qualification, vendor approval or customer addition
categories.new_geography: specific new geographic market entry or distribution expansion
categories.export_expansion: specific export market/customer/capacity/approval initiative beyond generic export ambition
categories.adjacent_vertical_or_use_case: credible expansion into an adjacent end market or use case using existing capabilities

orderbook_to_sales.numerator: latest explicit executable company order book known by anchor
orderbook_to_sales.denominator: latest trailing-twelve-month revenue or latest full-year revenue known by anchor, chosen without post-anchor information
include: letters of award where award is final and executable
orderbook_to_sales.currency_rule: convert only when document provides reliable currency/value basis; otherwise missing
orderbook_to_sales.multiple_order_documents: use latest disclosed total order book; do not sum individual orders on top of a disclosed total unless the company explicitly states they are incremental and the timing supports it

planned_capacity_increase_pct.formula: incremental announced nameplate capacity / pre-expansion nameplate capacity * 100
include: beds/seats/ports/lines/units where they are the company's core scalable operating capacity and are directly comparable
exclude: utilisation improvement without new nameplate capacity
planned_capacity_increase_pct.multiple_phases: include only phases explicitly committed or under implementation by anchor; aspirational later phases are excluded

minimum_management_execution_history_rul: Management execution scoring remains unavailable unless at least 3 pre-anchor commitments have independently closed by the anchor; this documentary holdout does not relax that rule.
